message: @opentelemetry/api-logs stays, since code in this package still imports it. Remove it once that code imports the Logs API from @opentelemetry/api.
@opentelemetry/exporter-jaeger has no 3.0 release. Remove it once no code uses it. Keeping it pins @opentelemetry/api below 1.10.0, which 3.0's instrumentation and sdk-node need.
@opentelemetry/shim-opentracing has no 3.0 release. Remove it once no code uses it. Keeping it pins @opentelemetry/api below 1.10.0, which 3.0's instrumentation and sdk-node need.
logs from @opentelemetry/api-logs is not rewritten in 0.1.0. Move it by hand.
